evidence: Modifies transaction creation and PSBT handling in src/wallet/feebumper.cpp, src/psbt.h, and GUI wallet interactions in src/qt/walletmodel.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a regression where defaulting to PSBTv2 causes watch-only GUI transactions exported to clipboard to be rejected by third-party wallet tools and signing hardware (#36518). Unresolved, this breaks common hardware wallet signing workflows for 32.0 users.
